content.short: 0xNAME is a public good naming service enabling FREE web3 names on Ethereum with various Top Level Names for communities and DAOs.
content.description: Digital identity is a right, not a product. Everyone deserves a Web3 name on Ethereum, not only those who can pay. 0xNAME embodies that. app.0xname.foo is a public-good, open-source, permissionless dApp that lets web3 users create FREE personal Web3 names with TLNs on Ethereum. 0xNAMEs are free to claim and use forever, because your name and identity are not commodities. They are not transferable and fully on-chain, and can be personalized via TLNs linked to communities, projects, DAOs, initiatives, and events. BEAST DAO is a decentralized cooperative building Ethereum infrastructure and public goods.
